name: Weedle
description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a poisonous barb of some sort. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.description: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. It reduces the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
